content.summary: Single-knob change: the generated code length is bound from shortener.code-length (ShortenerProperties, default 7, also set in application.yml). Raise it to 8; RandomCodeGenerator takes the length from configuration and the controllers' path templates accept 4-32 characters, so legacy codes keep resolving with no other change.

impactedModules.reason: shortener.code-length: 8 (explicit value overrides the record default).

apiChanges.change: Generated codes are 8 chars (was 7). Not a contract change; clients must not assume a length.

decisions.decision: Raise entropy by length (8 chars) rather than by alphabet.
decisions.rationale: Base62 is already the largest URL-safe unambiguous alphabet; one more character multiplies the keyspace by 62.

securityConsiderations: Random codes use crypto.randomBytes with rejection sampling; unchanged.
content.rollbackStrategy: Revert the default; 8-char codes already issued still resolve because the path templates accept 4-32.
